fields.title: The GitHub starter declares packages: read before any step uses it

sections.What we are doing instead: `template/.github/workflows/kac.yml` declares `packages: read` on its `validate` job. The restore and validate steps pass `github.token` as `KAC_REGISTRY_TOKEN`, and that token reads a GitHub Packages feed with this permission. A corpus `kac new` creates declares no `consumes:`, so until it does, no step in the job uses the permission.
sections.Why we need it: The starter restores from GitHub Packages with no edit to the pipeline, which is what [#1214](https://github.com/paul80nd/knowledge-as-code/issues/1214) asks. Without the permission, the first corpus to consume another fails `restore` with a 401, and its author has to find the missing line in a workflow they did not write.
sections.What the risk is: Every step in the job can read every package the repository's token is allowed to read, in a corpus that reads none. The permission is read-only, so a compromised step can read a package and cannot publish, delete or change one.
sections.What compensates:
* The permission is `read`, and the job grants no package write.
* A comment above the key says what it is for, and that a corpus consuming nothing, or only public feeds, can delete
  it along with the two `KAC_REGISTRY_TOKEN` lines.
* The job runs only the `kac` that `.config/dotnet-tools.json` pins, and actions pinned to a commit.
sections.How it closes:
It closes when the starter can declare the permission only for a corpus that consumes. That needs `kac new` or `kac update` to write it when `consumes:` gains an entry, or GitHub Actions to grant a permission conditionally. At the review date, weigh whether either exists. Where neither does, weigh whether [std-CI](https://github.com/paul80nd/knowledge-as-code/blob/0b33e205d64f9060cb2a2829d52c02981efd1834/examples/dog-fooding/standards/workflows.md) should admit a starter's read-only permission for a step it ships.

[#1219](https://github.com/paul80nd/knowledge-as-code/issues/1219) asked for this departure.
sections.Scope: The GitHub starter pipeline in `template/`, and every corpus `kac new` creates with `--ci github`. This repository's own workflows are not covered.
